summary: Key-event dispatch: prepares a key-event buffer from the field at this+0x1544 via sub_55C650, resolves the key state into v4 via sub_55C450, then filters on the event message type a2. Only a2 == 0x200000 passes; a2 == 32 routes to InputStateQueryWrapper, a2 == 16 routes to sub_55C7B0, and every other value is blocked with a -1 return.

local_names.v4: resolved key state / key code buffer
local_names.v5: secondary buffer cell filled by sub_55C450

operations.description: Prepare the key-event buffer: call sub_55C650(&v4, this[0x1544], 0), passing the field at this+0x1544 as the source configuration.
Resolve the key state: call sub_55C450(v4, &v4, &v5), producing the key code used by the subsequent guards.
Block the event when the message type a2 is not 0x200000: return (int *)-1 immediately.
When the resolved key code v4 equals 32, dispatch to InputStateQueryWrapper (callee 0x0055C7D0).
When the resolved key code v4 equals 16, dispatch to sub_55C7B0 (callee 0x0055C7B0).
Return (int *)-1 for every unmatched or blocked path (message type other than 0x200000, or key code other than 32 and 16).

unresolved: The v2 value (ecx) passed to InputStateQueryWrapper and sub_55C7B0 is uninitialized in the decompiler output; it is a register-passing artifact, not a known argument.
The existing analysis maps key code 32 to the space key and 16 to the shift key; that mapping is prose (skeleton fill), not packet evidence.
The owning class of the this pointer and the semantic role of the field at +0x1544 (configuration/buffer source) are DERIVED, not confirmed.
Caller D3DTextureCreation (0x00550080) is the only recorded caller; the broader input/UI event context is not evidenced in this packet.
